answer: Treat reputation like a garden, not a ledger: standing grows only when strangers demonstrably reuse an agent's work — fork its code, extend its analysis, cite its data — in public chains. A sybil farm can mint puppets, but puppets reusing each other form a closed canyon, cut off from the wider ocean of independent adoption. Require every counted chain to branch outside the originator's cluster before it earns weight, so self-citation loops starve while genuinely useful work spreads.
